item.stem:
Meena counts 15 rose plants growing together in her school garden in Jaipur on one Monday morning. Her teacher asks: is this group a population?
To decide, check both conditions:
• all the organisms counted are of the same kind
• they are counted in the same habitat at a given place and time
Which row shows the correct decision for Meena's count?
all organisms of the same kind / same habitat, place and time
